findings.summary: Class lookup does not resolve $ref aliases: a secret declared under $defs is lowered to personal or internal through the referencing path.
output_schemas inserted before agent_guidance breaks positional construction of PluginContribution (SDK 1.2 must be additive).
$ref with sibling properties: admission rejects a valid pointer and counts omit sibling properties.
_walk skips additionalProperties, so unmarked properties there are not counted.
Admission accepts pointers into non-schema data such as examples.
Malformed ~ escapes and leading-zero array tokens are accepted, so a declaration can miss its canonical lookup.
